text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer?
Ugh... I'm sorry, the truth is...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Last night, I was doing some leg training
to master wearing glass slippers, but—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I got so carried away that I greeted the morning doing squats!
My legs are shaking like jelly~!

It looks like she couldn't get much rest
due to a lack of sleep...
